Northwind Software - Employee Policy Handbook v4.1
Page 4
Maternity and paternity leave
Women employees get 26 weeks of paid maternity leave for the first two children and 12
weeks for any further child, as required by law. Fathers get 10 working days of paid paternity
leave, to be taken within 3 months of the birth.
Leave encashment
At the end of the year, earned leave above 30 days is paid out at the basic salary rate. When
you leave the company, all unused earned leave is paid out.
Public holidays
The company follows a list of 12 public holidays every year, published by the People team in
December. The list includes Republic Day, Independence Day, Gandhi Jayanti and festival
holidays chosen for each office.
Unpaid leave
If you have used all your paid leave, you can ask for up to 30 days of unpaid leave in a year.
Unpaid leave needs approval from your manager and the People team.
